syntax.exclude: Leave out a word or a phrase
syntax.title: Match the title only
syntax.short: A word of 3 letters or fewer matches whole words only

search.closeHint: Press Enter to close the search and keep the filter.

pills.renameHint: Right-click or press F2 to rename
pills.hint: Save a search for each role you want, e.g. {{example}}

announce.deleted: Saved search {{name}} deleted. Undo is available.

empty.homeBody: Add a blog, a newsletter, anything with a feed. Monfil pulls in what it publishes and never decides what you see.
empty.otherBody: This workspace has no sources yet. Import an OPML file to fill it in one go.

header.refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh feeds. Check your connection and try again.

saved.loadFailed: Saved items could not be loaded.
saved.empty: Save items from your feeds to find them here.

deleteFeed.removeBody_one: This removes <bold>{{title}}</bold> from {{workspace}}. It stays in {{count}} other workspace with its items.
deleteFeed.removeBody_other: This removes <bold>{{title}}</bold> from {{workspace}}. It stays in {{count}} other workspaces with its items.
deleteFeed.deleteBody_one: This removes <bold>{{title}}</bold> and its <bold>{{count}} item</bold>. Saved items remain available. There is no undo.
deleteFeed.deleteBody_other: This removes <bold>{{title}}</bold> and its <bold>{{count}} items</bold>. Saved items remain available. There is no undo.

deleteCategory.keepFeeds: Keep its feeds and move them to another folder instead
deleteCategory.title: Delete folder
deleteCategory.feeds_move_one: Its <bold>{{count}} feed</bold> moves to the folder below.
deleteCategory.feeds_move_other: Its <bold>{{count}} feeds</bold> move to the folder below.
deleteCategory.feeds_delete_one: Its <bold>{{count}} feed</bold> is deleted with it.
deleteCategory.feeds_delete_other: Its <bold>{{count}} feeds</bold> are deleted with it.

sidebar.addFeedHint: Add a feed here. To delete a feed, right-click it.
sidebar.filterHint: Click a feed to show only its articles. Click the eye to hide a feed.
